data.one_liner: Provides useful Unicode glyphs and plain ASCII alternatives for command-line applications.
data.what_it_does: This package contains getters for common Unicode characters and their ASCII equivalents. It supports a transparent ASCII mode switch for shells that cannot display Unicode.
use_when: You are building a command-line application that needs terminal glyphs.
You need fallback ASCII representations for terminals lacking Unicode support.
avoid_when: You are building a graphical user interface (GUI) application.
strengths: Ensures ASCII glyphs have the same character length to maintain terminal alignment.
Easy to toggle ASCII mode dynamically based on platform or environment.
weaknesses: Limited usefulness outside of command-line applications.
